Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
Overview
We are seeking a Contract Brand Specialist to support the marketing, launch, growth, and live-service operations of MLB The Show Mobile.
This role will be responsible for execution of integrated marketing campaigns, player engagement initiatives, cross-functional projects and asset production, contributing to the ongoing success of the Mobile business.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, passionate about mobile gaming and sports, comfortable working across multiple teams, and eager to grow their skills in brand marketing, live-service operations, and mobile growth strategy.
Responsibilities
Mobile Campaign Execution
Drive the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns for MLB The Show Mobile.
Coordinate timelines, assets, approvals, and deliverables across internal and external teams.
Assist with launch campaigns, content updates, seasonal programs, and promotional initiatives.
Maintain campaign trackers, status reports, and project documentation.
Helping create and evolve strategy for marketing of product
App Store & Platform Marketing Support
Coordinate assets, copy, and featuring nominations for event marketing on App Store and Google Play.
Partner with external vendor on App Store Optimization (ASO), including keyword research, metadata updates and localization.
Partner with external vendor on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), including test strategy, asset development and execution.
Track platform merchandising, featuring opportunities, and partner programs.
Live Service & Customer Engagement Support
Assist with the execution of live-content marketing campaigns and player engagement initiatives.
Support CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention, and reengagement programs.
Collaborate with product team on in-game messaging, content announcements, and promotional calendars.
Monitor player feedback, community conversations, and emerging opportunities.
Creative & Performance Marketing Support
Assist in the development and trafficking of creative assets across marketing channels.
Support A/B testing efforts for creative assets and app store content.
Collaborate with paid media team to monitor campaign performance data, review takeaways and align on optimizations.
Contribute ideas for improving player acquisition, engagement, and retention.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Partner with cross-functional teams, including paid media, product, analytics, creative, community, CRM, store publishing and external marketing agencies.
Work with insights teams to determine player insights to inform marketing strategy and execution
Track project milestones and communicate status updates to stakeholders.
Ensure marketing materials and deliverables are completed on time and meet quality standards.
Manage asset reviews with studio, legal and licensors, consolidating and applying feedback to gain approval.
Reporting & Market Insights
Monitor holistic marketing performance and deliver ongoing reporting.
Track competitor activity, mobile gaming trends, and sports marketing best practices.
Help identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and player engagement.
Qualifications
Required
2–4 years of experience in mobile app/game marketing
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail.
Passion for gaming, sports, and mobile experiences.
Preferred
Experience supporting mobile marketing campaigns.
Familiarity with App Store and Google Play ecosystems.
Experience with ASO/CRO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or live-service products.
Experience with programmatic media, analytics and campaign reporting.
Knowledge of baseball and MLB The Show.
Experience coordinating creative production workflows.
Success Metrics
Quality and timeliness of campaign execution
Accuracy and completeness of marketing deliverables
Support of live-content and engagement initiatives
Effectiveness of App Store marketing support
Stakeholder satisfaction
Contribution to player acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts

jobs.description: Amazon Quick is redefining how people work. It combines agentic AI, intelligent automation, and enterprise collaboration into a single productivity platform. Quick is the first enterprise SaaS product AWS has built that competes directly across multiple market segments - enterprise productivity, data and analytics solutions, AI native solutions. That places it in many commercial motions AWS has never run before especially for a managed AI service: seat-based subscription pricing, tiered discounts, promotional mechanics, private deals, and a channel ecosystem spanning direct sellers, account teams, GSIs, resellers, and ISV partners who are themselves built on AWS. We are at an inflection point. Quick has early enterprise traction, strong product velocity, and a pricing and billing infrastructure that must scale with it. The person in this role owns that infrastructure — not just as a compliance function, but as a growth lever. You will own the full commercial engine for Quick: pricing architecture, consumption-based billing models, private pricing strategy, promotional and discount frameworks, and deal enablement across a complex multi-party go-to-market. You will partner directly with AWS Billing IT and Ops teams, deals desks, strategic contracting teams and finance to build automated systems that accelerate the deal cycle and reduce operational friction. You will also partner with other product leaders across agentic AI services to develop common pricing frameworks. Key job responsibilities Own Quick's pricing and billing roadmap: list pricing, volume discounts, promotional mechanics, and private pricing constructs (EDP integrations, custom commit deals, partner-tier structures). Partner with AWS Billing IT to build scalable pricing models operationalized across sales, partner, and GTM motions. Serve as Quick's Deals Desk subject matter expert. Act as service-level approver for private deals and author 5Q/PRFAQ artifacts for new pricing capabilities. Design Quick's AI consumption billing model: metering units (tokens, credits, actions), rate structures, and overage mechanics. Build and ship automated billing workflows from deal intake through entitlement provisioning to invoice generation, with AWS BillGeneration and Billing Product teams. Define partner pricing tiers, discount frameworks, and margin guardrails across Quick's channel: direct sellers, account teams, GSIs, resellers, and ISV partners. Build pricing constructs that handle multi-year committed spend and flexible consumption as enterprises hedge across model families, silicon providers, and managed services. Extend pricing innovations from Quick to other AWS AI services. Write business narratives, competitive pricing analyses, and P&L models for AWS senior leadership. Define success metrics, instrument billing features, and iterate pricing strategy from observed customer behavior. A day in the life You start the morning reviewing the deal queue — a mix of new private pricing requests and deals approaching approval deadlines. You review strategy paper on a EDP deal that bundles Quick with some AWS services. Mid-morning, you're in a working session with AWS Billing engineering, reviewing the metering spec for Quick's token-credit abstraction layer. After lunch, you write the PRFAQ for a new promotional construct targeting ISV partners which is to be reviewed by AWS VP+ audience in a week. You close the day in a deep dive with finance, modeling three scenarios for Quick's FY28 cost structures About the team The Amazon Quick product team sits inside AWS and owns the full product lifecycle — from roadmap to GTM to commercial strategy. We work at the intersection of enterprise software, agentic AI, and AWS infrastructure economics. This is a small, high-caliber team with direct access to AWS senior leadership and a mandate to move fast. Billing and pricing is a first-class product discipline on this team, not a finance handoff.

jobs.description: Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. Job Category Sales Compensation Overview The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. Salary Range $139,400.00 - $230,000.00 Target Openings 1 What Is the Opportunity? The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in-person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Select business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams. As Sales Director, Select, you will lead a team of sales professionals within your agency assignments/territories to optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will have primary responsibility for sales strategy and business development within your agency assignments or territories and will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners. You will be out in the field attending meetings and building relationships with agents who are in need of support while also supporting the SE and Sr SEs who are assigned to the territory. This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy. What Will You Do? Select, train and manage a team of Sales Executives to develop long-term and short-term plans aligned with business objectives, achieve and exceed sales targets, and operate within Travelers' Vision and Values. Coordinate sales planning and quarterly performance reviews. Create an environment that fosters high performance, continuous learning, and proactive initative. Oversee and influence a team responsible for developing and implementing advanced sales strategies to expand and manage territory, with the objective of driving profitable growth. Own assigned territory, including development of business strategy, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and managing territorial performance. Conduct high-level agency diagnostics to identify growth opportunities, facilitate strategic appointments, and nurture long-term relationships. Proactively manage measures of point-of-sale success, sales plan effectiveness and customer satisfaction. Ensure the prospecting, onboarding and establishment of performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support. Oversee in-person office visits to strengthen key partnerships. Influence key agency partners through exceptional communication, negotiation, and leadership skills. Collaborate with internal teams, such as, Product, Underwriting, and Operations to ensure alignment of sales strategies with broader business objectives. Demonstrate the ability to build partnerships with other business groups to identify and initiate multiple product solutions at the account level. Leverage expertise in competitor products and market trends to enhance organizational learning and identify opportunities, serving as a significant resource for competitive intelligence and distribution channel insights in the region. Represent region or territory at agency council meetings and supports corporate agency management in handling strategic distribution relationships with key brokers and cross-enterprise resources. Utilize thorough knowledge of Travelers' systems, platforms, and sophisticated data and analytics to guide strategic sales decisions, measure performance metrics and identify opportunities for additional products and services to maintain a balanced portfolio. Analyze market, distribution channel and product offerings, identify gaps and strategic opportunities, and work with business partners to develop plan to increase market share and drive profitable growth. Ensure team leverages AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools. Perform other duties as assigned. What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have? Bachelor's degree in sales, marketing, business or related field. Eight or more years of insurance marketing and sales or related experience in managing and growing a high-value book of business, developing and executing successful sales strategies, conducting comprehensive agency diagnostics, and utilizing advanced data and analytics proficiently. Four or more years of experience in leadership and management of other employees. Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (or willingness to pursue). Expert knowledge of Travelers products and general Property & Casualty marketplace. Exceptional influencing, communication, and negotiation skills. Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally. Advanced skills in agency appointment. Ability to set clear direction by defining goals and priorities and energize others to meet these goals in a timely manner. Expert organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities. Goal-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving sales targets and business objectives. What is a Must Have? Five years of professional sales experience within the Insurance Industry. Two or more years of experience in leadership and management of other employees. Must live in the territory that they manage and have the ability to travel up to 50% of the time. What Is in It for You? Health Insurance : Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/ .

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
DART(Detection And Response Team)는 쿠팡 전사로 발생하는 사이버 위협을 탐지하고 대응하여 사이버 위협으로부터 발생할 수 있는 피해를 최소화하는데 목표를 두고 있습니다.
이런 목표 달성을 위해, 사이버 위협을 모니터링하고 탐지하는 CSOC(Cyber Security Operation Center)을 24x7 체계로 운영하고 있으며, CSOC은 SIEM과 SOAR를 이용하여 Usecase를 기반으로 생성된 탐지룰로 보안 모니터링을 수행하고 정오탐을 판별하여 초동 대응하는 역할을 합니다.
이후 보안사고로 이어질 수 있는 심각도가 높은 이벤트는 상위 조직인 DART로 Escalation하여 심층분석이 이루어지도록 하고, 개선방안을 도출하여 동일한 위협이 재발생하지 않도록 조치를 하고 있습니다.
***본 채용 건은 수습기간이 포함된, 24개월 계약직 채용입니다. (계약기간 : 26년 11월 1일~28년 10월 31일)
